{{Otheruses|Arrow}}
[[File:Cartoon_bows_and_arrows.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] fought with bows and arrows]]
{{Quote|A stone arrowhead will kill you just as dead as a blaster.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Radio">[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
An '''arrow''' was a projectile fired by a [[Bow/Legends|bow]]. Arrows were one of the earliest forms of ranged weapons, and soon proved effective in combat. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], arrows were considered to be primitive.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Arrows consisted of a shaft attached to a sharp head of some kind, with stabilizing fins attached at the rear. Arrows were widely considered to be primitive when compared to the galactic standard, and were often used by societies who lacked advanced technology, such as the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], or by societies who clung to their ancient roots, like the [[Tunroth]]. Despite this, some companies such as [[Drolan Plasteel]] made modern advancements on arrows, for use in their [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbows]].<ref name="JvS">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

Arrows as a general rule were useless against even [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] armors like [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] unless shot into the flexible bodysuit between armor plates, unless the bow in question was designed for a species with incredible strength, like the [[klirun]] bow, which could penetrate straight through such reinforced armor. However, some companies like Drolan Plasteel produced specialized plastic, metal, ceramic, and polyceramic arrows for use in their [[repeating crossbow]]s, with these arrows finding their way into other more contemporary arrow weapons like the [[Magna caster]] and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance]] [[Bolt-thrower]]; these arrows were often sturdier than their primitive counterparts and were capable of piercing armor with greater ease.<ref name="JvS" /> Additionally, these more advanced arrows could be custom made to contain toxins, knockout agents, acids, [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracers]] and [[Incendiary dart|incendiaries]].<ref name="JvS" />
